Author: Surepalli Nanda

 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 W.P.No.14389 Of 2023
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for General Administration,
learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition and learned Government Pleader for Home, appearing on behalf of respondents.

2. The petitioners have approached this Court, seeking the following relief:
"to pass an order direction or a writ particularly in the nature of writ of mandamus declaring the action of respondents in acquiring all that the property bearing Municipal No. 6-3-540/1, (Old Plot No.5) admeasuring 2000 Square yards situated at Erram manzil, Khairtabad, Hyderabad, T.S.
bounded by: North: Neighbours property, South: Road 40 feet, East: Neighbours property, West:
Road 25 feet, without adhering to THE RIGHT TO FAIR COMPENSATION AND TRANSPARENCY IN LAND ACQUISITION REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT, 2013 as illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional.

entities.text: RIGHT TO FAIR COMPENSATION AND TRANSPARENCY IN LAND ACQUISITION REHABILITATION AND RESETTLEMENT ACT, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Consequently this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to direct the respondents not to acquire the petitioner's property bearing Municipal No: 6-3-540/1, (Old Plot No.5) admeasuring 2000 Square yards situated at Erram manzil, Khairtabad Hyderabad, T.S without following The Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and may pass"
3.

entities.text: Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
The learned Assistant Government Pleader for Land Acquisition brings on record written instructions in W.P.No.14389 of 2023 on this day of 09th June, 2023 and the same read as under:
"It is humbly submitted that this respondent No.2 i.e. The special Deputy Collector FAC, Land Acquisition GHMC Hyderabad has not received any requisition for acquisition of an extent of 2000.00 square yards situated in Property bearing Municipal No.6-3-540/1 (Old Plot No.5), Erram manzil, Khairatabad, Hyderabad,
nor initiated any land acquisition proceedings under Act 30 of 2013."

4. Taking into consideration the specific contention of the 2nd respondent that the Special Deputy Collector (FAC), Land Acquisition, GHMC, Hyderabad has not received any requisition for acquisition of 2000 square yards pertaining to Property bearing Municipal No.6-3-540/1 (Old Plot No.5), Erram Manzil, Khairatabad, Hyderabad, nor initiated any land acquisition proceedings under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 in respect of the said subject land, this Court opines that the apprehension Mohammed Hussain vs State Of Teiangana on 9 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194856350/
1 of the petitioners is unfounded.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Consequently this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to direct the respondents not to acquire the petitioner's property bearing Municipal No: 6-3-540/1, (Old Plot No.5) admeasuring 2000 Square yards situated at Erram manzil, Khairtabad Hyderabad, T.S without following The Right To Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and may pass"
3.
It is however observed that in the event the respondents intend to take the petitioners subject land, due procedure, as per law, shall be followed.
5. Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of.
However, there shall be no order as to costs.
